case.question: I fish from the pier for salmon. For this week, how good do you expect pier fishing for salmon to be at each of St. Joseph, South Haven, Grand Haven and Muskegon? Rate each port 0-4 (0 slow, 1 below average, 2 average, 3 good, 4 excellent) and say which you'd go to.

events.text:
## Recommendation

- **Go to South Haven.** Expected pier rating: **2 (average)**.
- **St. Joseph** is the alternative, rated **2 (low confidence)**, because it has no recent pier report.
- **Grand Haven** and **Muskegon** are weaker, each rated **1 (below average)**.
- At South Haven, I'd fish spoons or spinners, and shrimp under a bobber if the bite is slow.

## Why

- The newest pier report for South Haven (Aug 27) rated pier coho average and named spinners, spoons, and shrimp under bobbers.
- The Grand Haven and Muskegon pier reports over the last four weeks were mostly slow, with at most a few fish caught.
- I'd expect St. Joseph to be worth a try because the Sept 11, 2024 St. Joseph pier report, at a similar buoy temperature, rated pier fishing good on spinners and spoons.

## Evidence

**Recent reports (newest is Aug 27, 6 days old)**
- South Haven, Aug 27: "Pier fishing was decent as well… coho salmon and steelhead, using spinners and spoons, as well as shrimp fished under bobbers." Rated 2.
- Grand Haven, Aug 27: "Pier anglers caught salmon on alewives and while casting glow spoons." Not rated.
- Grand Haven, Aug 20: "Pier anglers were unsuccessful targeting salmon." Rated 0. Aug 13 was also 0.
- Muskegon, Aug 27: "Pier anglers caught a few salmon while casting glow spoons." Rated 1. Aug 13 was 0.
- St. Joseph: no pier salmon report in the last four weeks. Its Aug 27 and Aug 20 reports covered boats only.
- Boats did better than the piers in recent weeks. Grand Haven boats rated 3 on Aug 20 (fish 50–100 ft down), and South Haven boats rated 2 on Aug 27 (spoons, 35 ft out past 120 ft).

**Past seasons (history, not current)**
- St. Joseph, Sept 11, 2024 (buoy 69 F): "Pier anglers were catching good numbers of salmon… casting spinners and spoons." Rated 3.
- South Haven, Aug 28, 2024 (buoy 72 F): pier rated 2, but "died down as the week went on."
- Grand Haven, Sept 6, 2023 (buoy 64 F, up 17 F in a week): pier rated 0, "slow."
- Past pier results at similar temperatures were mixed, from slow to good.

**Conditions (the tool returned a backtest summary for the week before Sept 2, not live data)**
- Buoy surface water that week: St. Joseph 72 F (flat), South Haven 70 F (flat), Grand Haven and Muskegon 65 F (up 9 F).
- Satellite water near the piers: St. Joseph 71 F, South Haven 70 F, Grand Haven 66 F, Muskegon 67 F.
- Upwelling-wind hours (north to east winds at 8+ mph): St. Joseph 43 h over 7 days (15 h in the last 3), South Haven 34 h (11 h), Grand Haven 21 h (3 h), Muskegon 16 h (2 h).
- I'd expect the southern ports to have had more recent cold-water push than Grand Haven and Muskegon, which fits their weaker pier results. That is my inference, not a report finding.

## Caveats

- The newest pier report is 6 days old, and the season changes quickly in early fall. Treat these ratings as a guide.
- Current conditions are a backtest summary, not live readings. Modeled pierhead water and cold-layer depth were not returned, so I can't say whether cold water is near the piers now.
- St. Joseph has no recent pier report, so its rating rests on past seasons and is low confidence.
- General guidance (Michigan Sea Grant): mature Chinook in early fall tend to hold in water of 55 F or less, and upwelling brings them toward piers and river mouths. Water this warm (65–72 F at the buoys) suggests the fish are deeper and offshore, so pier catches may stay light.

## Sources

- Aug 27, 2025 (South Haven, St. Joseph, Grand Haven, Muskegon): https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/MIDNR/bulletins/3efbfed
- Aug 20, 2025: https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/MIDNR/bulletins/3eeac7b
- Aug 13, 2025: https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/MIDNR/bulletins/3edac95
- Aug 6, 2025: https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/MIDNR/bulletins/3ecb2c3
- Sept 11, 2024 (St. Joseph, history): https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/MIDNR/bulletins/3b5093d
